title: Lost Circulation in Barail Formation X
symptoms: Sudden drop in flow-out (15-40%), pit level decrease, loss of standpipe pressure.
typical_causes: Depleted coal cleat systems and high permeability sand stringers under high differential pressure.
recommended_actions: Pre-treat active system with 25-35 ppb multi-modal LCM pill (NutPlug + Mica + Calcium Carbonate). Reduce ROP to <8 m/hr. Lower mud weight by 0.03 SG if pore pressure margin allows.
historical_stats: Resolved 8 of 9 historical events within 4 hours when proactive LCM pill was placed before penetrating top.

title: Well Kick & Gas Influx in Kopili Transition Zone
symptoms: Pit volume gain (>1 m3), flow out increase while pumps running, flow with pumps off.
typical_causes: Abrupt overpressure onset (1.50+ SG EMW) in under-compacted Kopili shale lenses.
recommended_actions: Immediate Hard Shut-In: Space out, shut down pumps, close annular preventer, record SIDPP & SICP. Execute Drillers Method.
historical_stats: 100% of Kopili influxes safely killed without casing seat breakdown when annular was closed within 2 minutes of pit gain alarm.

title: Differential Sticking in Surma Interbedded Sandstone
symptoms: High overpull when picking up off bottom, inability to rotate or reciprocate, full circulation maintained.
typical_causes: High overbalance pressure against permeable sandstones with thick filter cake.
recommended_actions: Spot pipe-freeing pill with lubricating surfactant. Jar down immediately with maximum allowable force while applying left-hand torque.
historical_stats: Jarring successful in 4 of 5 cases when initiated within 15 minutes of initial sticking.

title: Severe Torsional Vibration in Hard Surma Stringers
symptoms: Torque oscillation >35%, stick-slip harmonics, erratic top drive RPM.
typical_causes: Interbedded pyrite/chert nodules in Surma formation causing bit stalling.
recommended_actions: Optimize parameters: Increase RPM from 90 to 125, decrease WOB by 20%, pump high-lubricity glycol sweep.
historical_stats: Mitigated stick-slip in 6 of 7 occurrences, extending bit life by an average of 42 drilling hours.

title: Swelling Clays and Tight Hole in Girujan Clay
symptoms: Overpull >25 klbs on connections, drag during tripping, pack-off tendencies.
typical_causes: Smectite/illite reactive clay hydration and swelling into wellbore.
recommended_actions: Maintain KCl concentration >= 7%, add polyglycol shale inhibitor, perform frequent wiper trips.
historical_stats: Wiper trips reduced pack-off incidents by 85% across all 14 block wells.

title: Gas Channeling in Tipam Surface Casing
symptoms: Sustained casing pressure at surface, micro-annulus flow on CBL/VDL log.
typical_causes: Poor mud removal, cement slurry loss into porous Tipam sand, gas percolation during gelation.
recommended_actions: Pump engineered resin-enhanced thixotropic spacer with gas-block additive. Rotate casing during cementing.
historical_stats: Primary cement success rate reached 95% after adopting gas-tight slurry designs.

title: Mechanical Sloughing in High Angle Sections
symptoms: Large angular shale cavings on shaker, pack-off spikes on SPP.
typical_causes: Bedding plane shear failure in deviated wellbores (>25 deg inclination).
recommended_actions: Increase equivalent circulating density (ECD) by 0.03 SG, optimize flow rate for laminar hole cleaning.
historical_stats: Stabilized wellbore in 5 of 5 deviated wells without sidetracking.

title: Transition Zone Pore Pressure Ramp
symptoms: Connection gas peaks, d-exponent decrease, rising shale density gradient.
typical_causes: Trapped pore fluids under impermeable shale seals.
recommended_actions: Perform flow checks every 15m. Step up mud weight in 0.02 SG increments ahead of Kopili top.
historical_stats: Zero kicks experienced when mud weight was adjusted based on real-time d-exponent trend.
